healthy.title: Pond looks healthy
healthy.body: All current readings are in the safe range.

attention.title: Attention needed
attention.body: A reading is outside the safe range. Check it today.

urgent.title: Urgent action required
urgent.body: Fish may be in danger. Follow the steps below now.

unknown.title: Unable to verify pond condition
unknown.body: There is no recent reading, so we cannot tell if the pond is safe.

dissolved_oxygen.name: Oxygen in water
dissolved_oxygen.why: Fish breathe the oxygen in the water. Low oxygen can kill fish within hours, most often just before sunrise.
dissolved_oxygen.low: Oxygen is low. Fish may struggle to breathe.
dissolved_oxygen.lowCritical: Oxygen is dangerously low. Fish can die.

ph.name: pH (acid or alkaline)
ph.why: pH shows if the water is acidic or alkaline. Extreme or fast-changing pH stresses fish and makes ammonia more harmful.
ph.good: pH is in the safe range.
ph.lowCritical: The water is far too acidic.
ph.highCritical: The water is far too alkaline.

temperature.name: Water temperature
temperature.why: Warm water holds less oxygen, and fish need more oxygen as it warms. Sudden changes stress fish.
temperature.low: The water is cold. Fish eat and grow less.
temperature.lowCritical: The water is very cold. Fish are under stress.
temperature.high: The water is warm. Oxygen can drop quickly.
temperature.highCritical: The water is very hot. Fish are under stress.

water_level.name: Water level
water_level.why: A falling level can mean a leak or an open drain, and less water warms up and loses oxygen faster.

ammonia.name: Ammonia
ammonia.why: Ammonia comes from fish waste and uneaten feed. Too much damages gills. It is more harmful when pH and temperature are high.

nitrite.name: Nitrite
nitrite.why: Nitrite stops fish blood from carrying oxygen, so fish can suffocate even when oxygen in the water is fine.

alkalinity.name: Alkalinity
alkalinity.why: Alkalinity keeps pH steady. When it is low, pH can swing a lot between morning and afternoon.

measure.notMeasured: Not measured by the pond device
measure.stale: Old reading. It may not show the pond now.
measure.noRule: No safe range is set for this, so it is shown for information only.

actions.title: What to do now
dissolved_oxygen_low: Switch on the aerator now. Do not wait.
Check that the aerator is running and has power or fuel.
Check the oxygen reading again when a fresh reading arrives.
ph_low: Test the water again with a pH kit to confirm.
Compare with earlier readings taken at the same time of day.
Check for heavy rain, run-off or chemicals added to the pond.
Do not add lime or other chemicals because of one reading. Ask a fisheries expert first.
ph_high: Test the water again with a pH kit to confirm.
Compare with this morning's reading. pH rises in the afternoon when algae are thick.
Keep aerators running and avoid heavy feeding.
Do not add chemicals because of one reading. Ask a fisheries expert before correcting a big change.
temperature_high: Check the oxygen reading too: warm water holds less oxygen.
Feed less until the water cools.
Do not add a large amount of new water at once. Sudden change stresses fish.
temperature_low: Feed less until the water warms.
Check for cold water flowing into the pond.
Do not add a large amount of new water at once. Sudden change stresses fish.
ammonia_high: Check pH and temperature: high values make ammonia more harmful.
Do not add lime to fix ammonia. Ask a fisheries expert if it stays high.
nitrite_high: Reduce feeding for now and keep aerators running.
Ask a fisheries expert before adding salt or any chemical.
stale: Look at the fish. If they gasp at the surface, switch on the aerator.
Check that the pond device has power.
Check the device's Wi-Fi or mobile signal.
Readings will update here by themselves when the device sends again.
actions.always: If fish are gasping at the surface or dying, switch on the aerator and call a fisheries expert. Do not wait for a reading.
actions.verify: After acting, wait for a fresh reading to check the pond is recovering.
actions.general: General advice only. Adapt it to your fish and your pond.

reconnecting.title: Reconnecting
reconnecting.body: Trying to restore the live connection. Showing the last readings.

noInternet.title: No internet
noInternet.body: This phone or computer is offline. The readings shown are from before.

serviceDown.title: Can't reach PondFix
serviceDown.body: The PondFix service did not answer. Your internet may still be working. The readings shown are from before.

deviceOffline.title: Pond device not reporting
deviceOffline.body: No reading from the pond device for {{age}}. Check its power and Wi-Fi.

delayed.title: Data delayed
delayed.body: The latest reading is {{age}} old. It may not show the pond now.

unknown.title: Status unknown
unknown.body: We cannot check the connection right now.
